banner.title: The Fischer Hints magic items - Joe Fischer's judge toybox (folios 12-13, 26): the chest-trap table, Monster Gems and the Room of Gems, the Hobbits' Pipe with five pipeweeds, and the rings, the bag, the helm
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 2 (August 1976): folios 12-13, Joe Fischer's Hints for D&D Judges Part 3 - The Dungeons (the Marc Kurowski magic-item set, the chest-trap table, Monster Gems); folio 26, the Hints continuation - the Room of Gems and the Pool of Endless Ogres. The items are the unit of this round per the adjudication. OD&D-era ink converted per the walk doctrine: the pin IS the conversion, noted, never silent.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. These are judge-toybox variant items on the variant layer - the engine's canon items are untouched; the ranges ride as printed with the 1e terms noted. The wandering-monster sub-tables, the transport-to-fiction areas and the maze guidance on folio 26 are judge-craft prose, noted here and never pinned - the honest boundary of the items round.

audit_comment: THE FISCHER HINTS MAGIC ITEMS - Round C of issue 2 (folios 12-13, 26), the judge's toybox on the variant layer. THE CHEST TRAPS (folio 12): the d100 split - 0-50 a normal chest, 51-00 the trap sub-table: 1-4 spring-loaded daggers at 0-30, the poisoned daggers at 31-50, the gas at 51-65, the Mirror of Life Trapping chest at 66-75, the 2-7-dice explosion at 76-85, the enraged spectre at 86-90, the level loss within 5 feet at 91-95, the magic item loss at 96-98, and the intelligent 2nd-9th level magic-user chest at 99-00 - plus the screaming intelligent gold. THE GEMS AND POOLS (folios 13, 26): Monster Gems - 500 gold pieces, a wandering-dungeon monster on command, kobold to red dragon, a week of service, monster and gem dying together; the Room of Gems - three turns after removal half the hoard turns orc; the Pool of Endless Ogres - one ogre a turn. THE PIPE (folio 13): the Hobbits' Pipe - four ordered smoke rings a turn at 4 inches, living 1-6 turns, three uses a day, carrying the wizards'-garden pipeweeds: Tranquillity (6-inch radius, 3 turns, morale plus one, 1-4 longer in the pipe), Stoning (6 inches, saves allowed, 25 percent backfire cut to 10 in the pipe), Illusion (a Phantasmal Force, failing in high wind, 1-4 turns longer in the pipe), Acapulco (everyone a friend, 2-12 turns, defend at minus 3, saves in the pipe). THE ITEMS (folio 13): the Ring of Magic Missiles - 10 charges, two a volley, two spells per missile restored; the Bag of Infinite Wealth - 100 gold pieces a day; the Helm of Forgetfulness - disguised as a Helm of Teleportation, saves at minus 1 for Int 13-15 and minus 2 for 16-18, a made save leaving partial loss; the Ring of Infravision - the spell while worn. HONEST BOUNDARIES: the wandering-monster sub-tables, the transport-to-fiction areas and the maze guidance on folio 26 are judge-craft prose, noted here and never pinned; all ink is OD&D-era variant, converted, noted, never silent. The Alchemist box flips this round - the issue-2 report's second flip, 2 closed / 2 open.
